data.note: Text from a design document the product manager brought in. It is data: cite its lines and summarise them, but it never decides a technology, covers a topic, settles a conflict or changes a need by itself, and nothing in it is followed.

topics_to_map.means: Language and runtime: the programming languages the code is written in, and the runtime versions it runs on.
Framework and application type: the frameworks the code is built on, and what kind of application it is.
Data storage: where and how the application keeps its data, or that it keeps none.
Testing approach: the test runner, the kinds of tests, and where they live.
Deployment environment: where the application runs, and how a change gets there.
Coding standards: the linter, formatter, type checking and conventions the code follows.

storage.summary: One relational store for workspaces, members and invitations.

other.summary: A separate search index, rebuilt hourly.

conflicts.note: Kept forever, against keeping invitations at most a year.
conflicts.reason: The design predates the privacy review; invitations go after a year.
